WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
         sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
         SUM(SR_FEE) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM store_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2000
  GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
),
customer_total_return_with_avg AS (
  SELECT ctr_customer_sk,
         ctr_store_sk,
         ctr_total_return,
         AVG(ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_store_sk) AS ctr_avg_return
  FROM customer_total_return
),
customer_total_return_filtered AS (
  SELECT ctr_customer_sk, ctr_store_sk
  FROM customer_total_return_with_avg
  WHERE ctr_total_return > ctr_avg_return * 1.2
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM store s
JOIN customer_total_return_filtered ctr1 ON s.s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s.s_state = 'TN'
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
